The message you keep and see stays exactly as you wrote it — only the request copy is rewritten. Numbers, paths, quoted wording and code blocks are kept verbatim; on timeout, error or a failed guard the original text is sent. Costs one extra fast-model request.
No extra check on the reply.
A self-check hint is appended inside the same turn: no extra request, and the verdict comes from the same model — it is not independent verification.

After the reply is written, one read-only review request is made (fast model preferred) and billed separately. It only reads text, runs no tools and does not replay the task — it cannot replace a real build or test run.
How a message sent mid-run is delivered

Insert-before-next-step hands your text to the model before its next safe step. A request that is already sent and a tool that is already running are not interrupted or rewritten. Messages with attachments still go to the queue.

Only request headers and a short tool-usage hint are adjusted, decided locally from the current provider and model. Auto sends no probe request. An incompatible profile falls back to native — no official permission, credentials or identity is ever faked.
This profile does not fit the current model; the request is sent natively.

Let this conversation search this assistant\'s documents
Import and search stay on this device. When enabled, the snippets that match your message are sent with the request to this conversation\'s model — only the matched snippets, never a whole document.
Adds a short execution hint to the system prompt (read before edit, narrowest diff, only the checks that can fail). It is guidance only and does not guarantee the best strategy.
